interfaces.usb: USB_VBUS is the USB connector side before D4; GND_LOGIC common with USB ground
interfaces.logic: 3V3_LOGIC powers official ESP32-C3 module and U1 VCC1
interfaces.can: 5V_BUS powers U1 VCC2 and U2 input; GND_BUS is NET-C

integration_notes: U2 and U3/U4 pad geometry verified against primary manufacturer drawings. Other exact MPN/landpatterns come from separate sourcing pass.
F1 retained until sourcing picks exact replacement, but its value must cover worst-case bus input around0.5A.
Do not connect GND_LOGIC to GND_BUS, including USB shield.
SS14 diode cathodes join at5V_SYS. These prevent bulk backfeed, but semiconductor leakage is finite; not a safety disconnect.
Keep primary and secondary domains separated by3.2mm functional isolation barrier; no safety certification implied.
An assembled prototype must still be electrically tested; component/module certifications do not certify the completed network node.
